title: Ezekiel is bound and made mute as a sign of judgment
description: After the Spirit has lifted Ezekiel up, he is told to shut himself in his house. People are to lay ropes on him and bind him, and God will cause his tongue to stick to the roof of his mouth so that he becomes mute and cannot rebuke the people. But when God speaks to him, his mouth shall be opened so that he can say: 'Thus says the Lord God.' Whoever wishes to hear may hear; whoever refuses to hear, let them refuse—for they are a rebellious house.
